cond: EVERY FIGURE HERE IS FROM NVIDIA'S OWN RELEASES, ITS 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED 26 JULY 2026, OR NAMED PRESS COVERAGE OF THE 26 AUGUST EARNINGS CALL. || ⚠️ FIRST, THE YEAR. NVIDIA'S FISCAL YEAR ENDS IN LATE JANUARY. THE "70%" WAS SAID ABOUT **FISCAL 2028**, THE YEAR ENDING JANUARY 2028. FISCAL 2027, THE YEAR WE ARE IN, IS ALREADY RUNNING AT ROUGHLY PLUS 90% ON CONSENSUS OF $411.49 BILLION FROM 52 ANALYSTS. SO ANYONE READING "70% GROWTH IN 2027" IS UNDERSTATING THE CURRENT YEAR. || SECOND, "DOUBLE" AND "70%" ARE NOT TWO VERSIONS OF ONE NUMBER. Huang on 17 September, at a summit in Scotland: "I expect Nvidia to sell twice as many chips this next year as we do this year." THAT IS **UNITS**, CALENDAR 2027 VS 2026. The 70% was said three weeks earlier on the 26 August call and is **DOLLARS**, fiscal 2028. Different quantity, different unit, different period, different day. || THIRD, THE $673 BILLION IS NOT A COMPANY FIGURE AT ALL. IT IS CNBC APPLYING THE 70% TO THE THEN-CURRENT CONSENSUS BASE. Marketplace ran the same arithmetic off a later base and got "$690 billion to $700 billion". ⚠️ IT IS NOT BOOKINGS, NOT GUIDANCE, AND NOT A MARKET SIZE. The genuine cumulative figure Huang gave at GTC on 16 March 2026 was "I see through 2027 at least $1 trillion" of demand and purchase orders for Blackwell and Rubin - and THAT one is CUMULATIVE AND MULTI-YEAR, not one year's revenue. || ⚠️ AND HUANG HIMSELF FLAGGED THE STATUS OF THE 70%: "It is the case that we've never forecasted, never guided to a year in advance." NVIDIA'S ONLY FORMAL GUIDANCE IS ONE QUARTER: Q3 FY2027 REVENUE OF "$108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%" WITH GROSS MARGIN OF "74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points" - AND, IMPORTANTLY, "NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook." THE ONLY FULL-YEAR ITEM IN THE OUTLOOK IS A TAX RATE. || THE ACTUAL RESULTS, WHICH ARE EXTRAORDINARY AND WHICH THE SLIDE BURIES: Q2 FY2027, QUARTER ENDED 26 JULY 2026 - REVENUE $96.2bn UP 106%, DATA CENTRE $89.0bn UP 117%, GAAP GROSS MARGIN 75.0%, GAAP OPERATING INCOME $63.7bn UP 124%, GAAP NET INCOME $59.7bn UP 126%, GAAP DILUTED EPS $2.46 UP 128%. FY2026 revenue was $215.9bn up 65%. Trailing twelve months $302.9bn. || ⚠️⚠️ THE THREE THINGS THE SLIDE DOES NOT MENTION, AND THEY ARE WHAT ACTUALLY MATTER TO US. (1) MARGIN. Gross margin is 75.0% now, guided to 74.0% next quarter, and reportedly 71-72% in Q4 FY2027 before settling at 72-73% in FY2028, on memory prices. 70% REVENUE GROWTH WITH THREE POINTS OF MARGIN COMPRESSION IS A DIFFERENT EARNINGS STORY FROM 70% AT A CONSTANT MARGIN. (2) CONCENTRATION. The 10-Q says verbatim: "Five direct customers accounted for 22%, 14%, 13%, 11%, and 10% of our accounts receivable balance as of July 26, 2026" - SEVENTY PERCENT OF RECEIVABLES IN FIVE CUSTOMERS, up from three customers at 25/18/13 in January. (3) THE CIRCLE. NVIDIA HOLDS $51,157 MILLION OF NON-MARKETABLE EQUITY SECURITIES, "primarily in privately-held companies" - and secondary analyses of the same 10-Q put total equity investments near $99bn and supply and capacity commitments at $279bn, up from $119bn a quarter earlier. ⚠️ THOSE SECONDARY FIGURES CONFLICT WITH EACH OTHER AND ARE NOT VERBATIM FILING TEXT - I REPORT THEM AS UNVERIFIED. BUT THE DIRECTION IS CLEAR AND IT IS THE SAME PATTERN THIS BOARD RECORDED FOR GOOGLE AT TERAWULF AND AMAZON AT GENERAC: THE SELLER IS FUNDING THE BUYER. WHEN A SUPPLIER INVESTS IN ITS OWN CUSTOMERS, SOME OF THE REVENUE GROWTH IS ITS OWN MONEY COMING BACK. || 🎯 DOES ANY OF THIS CHANGE OUR PLAN? NO, AND THE PLAN WAS ALREADY BUILT FOR THIS. NVDA IS THE LARGEST POSITION ON THE BOARD - 420 SHARES, $79,380.28 OF COST, 13.9% OF ALL INVESTED CAPITAL, $15,619.72 OF THE $95,000 BUDGET STILL UNSPENT. THERE ARE ALREADY THREE ROWS AGAINST IT: AN $8,000 EARNINGS DECISION ON 18 NOVEMBER AND TWO STANDING LIMIT ROWS OF $7,000 AND $5,619.72. THOSE ROWS DO NOT NEED CHANGING BECAUSE A CEO REMARK AT A CONFERENCE IS NOT A TRIGGER. THE TRIGGER IS THE PRINT. || AT THE 17 SEPTEMBER CLOSE OF $219.34 THE POSITION IS WORTH $92,122.80 AGAINST $79,380.28 OF COST - PLUS $12,742.52, OR 16.05%. THE BOARD CARRIES IT AT 25.7x TRAILING EARNINGS AND 17.5x FORWARD, WHICH FOR A COMPANY GROWING REVENUE 106% IS NOT AN EXPENSIVE MULTIPLE - IT IS THE CHEAPEST FAST-GROWING NAME ON THE BOARD ON A PRICE-TO-EARNINGS-GROWTH BASIS AT 0.4. THE RISK HERE HAS NEVER BEEN THE MULTIPLE. IT IS THAT 13.9% OF OUR CAPITAL SITS IN ONE COMPANY WHOSE FIVE LARGEST CUSTOMERS ARE ALSO, INCREASINGLY, COMPANIES IT HAS INVESTED IN. CONVICTION HIGH ON HOLDING, MEDIUM ON ADDING, AND THE 18 NOVEMBER ROW STAYS EXACTLY AS WRITTEN. || WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: GROSS MARGIN GUIDED BELOW 70%, OR TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS OF DECELERATING DATA CENTRE REVENUE, OR THE 10-Q SHOWING CUSTOMER-INVESTMENT COMMITMENTS GROWING FASTER THAN DATA CENTRE REVENUE.
dl: NVDA - the "70%" is FISCAL 2028, not 2027, and the $673bn is a journalist's arithmetic
w: THE SLIDE WELDED TOGETHER TWO REAL BUT SEPARATE STATEMENTS MADE THREE WEEKS APART. ⚠️ THE 70% APPLIES TO FISCAL 2028, NOT 2027 - AND FY2027 IS ALREADY RUNNING AT ABOUT +90%. THE SLIDE UNDERSTATES THIS YEAR WHILE SOUNDING LIKE IT OVERSTATES IT.

cond: NO NEW RESEARCH WAS NEEDED FOR THIS SLIDE - THE CLAIM WAS ALREADY VERIFIED YESTERDAY AND IT CHECKS OUT. Huang, 17 September 2026, at a summit in Scotland, verbatim: "I expect Nvidia to sell twice as many chips this next year as we do this year." THAT IS CHIPS - UNITS - FOR CALENDAR 2027 AGAINST CALENDAR 2026. Money & Banking renders it as ยอดขายชิป (chip sales volume) พุ่งเท่าตัว (doubling). CORRECT. It makes no dollar claim at all, and that restraint is the mark of a professional desk. || 🎯 THE LESSON IS THE VALUABLE PART, AND IT ARRIVED BY ACCIDENT. THE SAME SENTENCE, FROM THE SAME MAN, ON THE SAME DAY, REACHED THIS BOARD TWICE IN TWENTY-FOUR HOURS. THE ANONYMOUS VERSION WELDED IT TO A SEPARATE STATEMENT MADE THREE WEEKS EARLIER ABOUT **FISCAL 2028 REVENUE**, ATTACHED A **$673 BILLION** FIGURE THAT WAS A JOURNALIST'S ARITHMETIC ON A CONSENSUS BASE, AND LABELLED THE WHOLE THING "2027". THE NAMED, DATED, PROFESSIONAL OUTLET SAID ONE TRUE THING AND STOPPED. || 💡 THE THREE MARKS OF A SOURCE WORTH READING, ALL VISIBLE WITHOUT ANY FINANCIAL KNOWLEDGE: IT IS **DATED** (18 ก.ย. 2569, PRINTED TOP LEFT). IT IS **NAMED** (Money & Banking Online, with its website on the page). AND IT **CLAIMS LESS THAN IT COULD** - no dollar target, no exclamation mark, no "details in the comments". ⚠️ A SOURCE THAT CLAIMS LESS IS USUALLY WORTH MORE. That test costs nothing to apply and it would have caught both of the last two bad slides. || NOTHING CHANGES ON THE BOARD. NVDA IS 420 SHARES AT $79,380.28 OF COST, 13.9% OF ALL INVESTED CAPITAL, WORTH $92,122.80 AT THE 17 SEPTEMBER CLOSE OF $219.34 - PLUS $12,742.52 OR 16.05%. $15,619.72 OF THE $95,000 BUDGET REMAINS. THE 18 NOVEMBER $8,000 EARNINGS ROW AND THE TWO STANDING LIMIT ROWS STAND UNCHANGED. || ⚠️ AND THE CAUTION FROM YESTERDAY STANDS TOO, BECAUSE THIS SLIDE DOES NOT ADDRESS IT: DOUBLING THE NUMBER OF CHIPS SOLD IS NOT THE SAME AS DOUBLING PROFIT. GROSS MARGIN IS 75.0% NOW AND GUIDED TO 74.0% NEXT QUARTER, AND THE MEMORY WORK DONE TONIGHT SHOWS WHY THAT PRESSURE IS REAL - CONVENTIONAL DRAM CONTRACT PRICES ROSE ABOUT FIVE TIMES IN A YEAR AND NVIDIA BUYS MEMORY BY THE TONNE. MORE UNITS AT A THINNER MARGIN IS A DIFFERENT INVESTMENT FROM MORE UNITS AT THE SAME MARGIN. THE PRINT ON 18 NOVEMBER IS THE TRIGGER, NOT THE HEADLINE.
dl: 💡 THE SAME NVDA STORY, TOLD CORRECTLY THIS TIME - a live lesson in source quality
w: MONEY & BANKING'S 18 SEPTEMBER HEADLINE SAYS NVIDIA EXPECTS NEXT YEAR'S **CHIP SALES** TO DOUBLE. THAT IS ACCURATE - IT IS THE UNITS CLAIM, CORRECTLY RENDERED. THE ANONYMOUS POST 24 HOURS EARLIER TURNED THE SAME REMARK INTO "70% GROWTH TO $673 BILLION", WHICH WAS WRONG IN THE YEAR, THE UNIT AND THE SOURCE.
